title: Ombudsman suspends Cavite town mayor amid illegal gambling probe

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman imposed a preventive suspension against Rosario, Cavite Mayor Jose Voltaire Ricafrente over his alleged involvement in gambling activities at a casino in Bacolod City. According to the Office of Ombudsman on Thursday, the case stemmed from a complaint filed by its Field Investigation Office I after conducting an investigation into Ricafrente’s alleged gambling activities.
